title: HTTP contract
decisions: Use REST under /api/v1 for public commands and queries.
Publish OpenAPI as a verifiable contract.
Return Problem Details for HTTP errors.
Use pagination, filtering, and sorting with explicit limits.
Propagate a correlation ID across requests, logs, and integrations.
Use SignalR only for real-time notifications, never as a replacement for the command API.

responseConventions.success: An explicit DTO with a semantic HTTP status
responseConventions.idempotency: Required for external commands that can be retried
